name: Crystal Psiborg (Psionic)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Psicrystal Affinity*, manifester level 1st.

Benefit(s): Your psicrystal transforms into a single piece of psibertech*, granting you the base augmentation of that psibertech component. The psicrystal is now attached to your body and can no longer move or leave your body (assuming it ever could), but gains hardness equal to 5 + 1/2 your manifester level. A psibertech psicrystal still grants all the normal benefits for being within 5 feet of you (such as the Alertness feat) and continues to function if the psicrystal is consumed or integrated as a result of another feat or class feature (such as the crystal warrior’s form astral suit class feature or the Mech Piloting* feat).
